audit.why: Akshan owns level 1-2 on range (Avengerang 850, revolver autos) against an Akali with only Five Point Strike; Akali takes 3-5 once Twilight Shroud is ranked and again at first item; level 6 is his because Comeuppance out-ranges her commit. The full-layer phase sides and the content win chart already agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 and Level 6 phase text were the generic template — no ability, no cooldown, no instruction.
audit.why: The level-1 constraint is Avengerang's 850 range on a 9s cooldown plus the Dirty Fighting third-hit shield; the level-6 constraint is Comeuppance (100s at rank 1), which Riot's text says hits the first champion, minion or structure — so the wave itself is the counterplay, and Heroic Swing (18s at rank 1) is the window to attack.
audit.corrected: Comeuppance is 100s and stops on the first minion hit — stand behind your wave, then E in when Heroic Swing (18s) is spent.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two real errors. (a) Key Ability Interactions described Heroic Swing only as "his dash + camera swing escape" and stated no interaction. (b) The content layer attributes Akshan's revive to Dirty Fighting (P) in four places — the revive is Going Rogue (W); Dirty Fighting is the every-third-hit bonus damage and shield.
audit.why: Riot's text: Heroic Swing hooks into terrain and 'gets knocked off when colliding with champions or terrain' — walking into his swing path ends it, which is the decisive interaction nobody wrote down. Comeuppance damages 'the first champion, minion, or structure hit', so a caster minion eats it. Going Rogue is the Scoundrel resurrect; Dirty Fighting is the shield that absorbs the front of your burst.
audit.corrected: Heroic Swing needs terrain and ends the moment it collides with a champion — body-block it. Comeuppance stops on the first minion hit.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere in this matchup (sequencingCues 0).
audit.why: Heroic Swing 18/16.5/15/13.5/12 and Comeuppance 100/85/70 are the two punishable cooldowns; the edits now key the all-in to both.

notes: The revive belongs to Going Rogue (W) — it triggers on killing a Scoundrel, an enemy who killed one of his allies. Dirty Fighting (P) is the every-third-hit bonus damage plus shield. The content layer had this backwards in four places; all four are corrected here. The packet's two suspectNames ('Twilight Shroud's', 'Drop Twilight Shroud') are false positives. Unverified and therefore not written: whether Twilight Shroud reveals Akshan out of Going Rogue camouflage — _missing/akali.json asserts it, but neither Riot description supports it, so the edits rely on camouflage breaking away from brush/terrain instead. Only 57 games at Emerald+ (52.2% win rate), so treat the rating as thin data.
